title: MiniMax
description:
A component that connects to MiniMax's large language models for advanced 
natural language processing. It enables capabilities like long-context reasoning, 
agentic workflows, multi-step tool use, and high-quality conversational generation. 
MiniMax offers an OpenAI-compatible API with strong performance across reasoning, 
writing, and coding tasks. The component is suitable for integrating MiniMax models 
into pipelines where extended context windows and efficient inference are important.
